description:
The committed Rust dependency graph carries advisories that the current RustSec database reports, so the blocking dependency audit fails on every branch. This issue clears them within semver-compatible updates, as @/charter/D-11 requires for v1.0.

## Background

- `cargo audit -D warnings` against main's `Cargo.lock` reports ten vulnerabilities and two denied warnings in `rustls`, `rustls-webpki`, `webpki-roots` (through `ureq`), `pulldown-cmark`, `h2`, `tokio` (unsound `AsyncFd` constructors) and `pin-utils` (unmaintained, through `hyper` and `futures-util`), among others.
- The earlier remediation (d3709cc6) left the graph advisory-free; these advisories were published after it.
- The dependency audit is a configured, blocking gate and its policy has no ignore list.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cargo audit -D warnings` exits zero against the committed `Cargo.lock` with no advisory ignore, allowlist or other audit-policy change.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every dependency change is a semver-compatible lockfile update; no manifest version requirement is raised across a major version, no dependency is replaced, and no feature set changes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Workspace formatting, clippy with zero warnings, all-target and all-feature builds, and the Rust test suites pass after the update, with CLI and server verified together.

## Notes

- Blast radius: `Cargo.lock`, and only source or tests that a semver-compatible API change requires.
- An advisory that only a major bump, a dependency swap, a feature change or an audit ignore can clear is out of scope for this issue and needs a separate decision.
title: Clear the Rust dependency advisories reported against the current lockfile
